# Design System — Extended

> Scope: static element samples from the captured region. Names beginning with `measured-` identify exact source measurements, not global design rules. In a mix, these are unblended source references.

## Overview

**Identity:** Stripe
**Summary:** Design system for Stripe landing page featuring dynamic gradients, clean light surfaces, elegant typographic hierarchy using Soehne, and rounded UI components.
**Density:** Balanced layout with clear typographic hierarchy and ample breathing room
**Layout philosophy:** Fluid, section-based grid layout with high emphasis on visual graphics and modular content cards.

### Tone and personality

- Professional
- Modern
- Tech-Forward
- Clean
- Reliable
- Innovative
- Sophisticated

- Use subtle borders (#E5EDF5) around cards to maintain light elevation structure.

dos: Use subtle borders (#E5EDF5) around cards to maintain light elevation structure.
Maintain thin/light font weights (300) for large display headlines to match brand visual tone.
Ensure primary CTA buttons use the brand primary color #533AFD with white readable text.
donts: Do not use dark heavy borders on card containers.
Do not use high-opacity heavy drop shadows on elevated elements.
Do not mix sans-serif font families outside of the main Soehne typographic system.

iteration_guide: Use token references like {colors.brand.primary} when extending UI elements.
Keep card rounded corners aligned with 6px token standards for modular bento layouts.
agent_prompt_guide: Generate clean modern interfaces matching Stripe's light aesthetic using #061B31 primary text, #533AFD accent blue buttons, 6px border radii on cards, and light typography weights for display headings.
quick_start: Set primary font to Soehne or SF Pro Display.
Use #533AFD for primary buttons with 4px border radius.
